script:
set -e
result=$(mktemp /run/aresos-json.XXXXXX)
trap 'rm -f "$result"' EXIT
{
python3 -c 'import json,pathlib,stat,time
folders=('"'"'/var/lib/ares/records'"'"', '"'"'/run/ares-owner-diagnostics'"'"')
def records():
    found=[]
    for folder in folders:
        root=pathlib.Path(folder)
        if not root.exists():
            assert not root.is_symlink(), '"'"'Diagnostic directory is a broken link'"'"'
            continue
        info=root.lstat()
        assert stat.S_ISDIR(info.st_mode) and not root.is_symlink() and info.st_uid==0 and stat.S_IMODE(info.st_mode)==0o700, '"'"'Diagnostics are not private'"'"'
        for p in root.glob('"'"'*.json'"'"'):
            info=p.lstat()
            assert stat.S_ISREG(info.st_mode) and not p.is_symlink() and info.st_uid==0 and stat.S_IMODE(info.st_mode)==0o600, '"'"'Diagnostic record is not private'"'"'
            found.append(p)
    return found
before=set(['"'"'/var/lib/ares/records/disks.json'"'"', '"'"'/var/lib/ares/records/20261027T185801.036427Z-install.json'"'"', '"'"'/var/lib/ares/records/prepared.json'"'"', '"'"'/var/lib/ares/records/20261027T185828.633625Z-prepare.json'"'"', '"'"'/var/lib/ares/records/20261027T185901.115672Z-prepare.json'"'"', '"'"'/var/lib/ares/records/network-verified.json'"'"', '"'"'/var/lib/ares/records/20261027T200013.706948Z-title.json'"'"', '"'"'/var/lib/ares/records/20261027T200031.692977Z-records.json'"'"', '"'"'/var/lib/ares/records/20261027T200058.754698Z-export.json'"'"', '"'"'/var/lib/ares/records/20261027T200140.986443Z-title.json'"'"', '"'"'/var/lib/ares/records/20261027T200536.679124Z-title.json'"'"', '"'"'/var/lib/ares/records/record-c.json'"'"', '"'"'/var/lib/ares/records/title.json'"'"', '"'"'/var/lib/ares/records/20261027T200554.126371Z-records.json'"'"'])
deadline=time.monotonic()+1800
while time.monotonic()<deadline:
    paths=[p for p in records() if str(p) not in before and p.name.endswith('"'"'-login.json'"'"')]
    if paths:
        assert len(paths)==1, '"'"'Ambiguous owner command records'"'"'
        result=json.loads(paths[0].read_text())
        assert result['"'"'status'"'"'] in ('"'"'passed'"'"','"'"'stopped'"'"')
        print(json.dumps(result));break
    time.sleep(.5)
else: raise SystemExit('"'"'Owner command did not finish'"'"')
'
} > "$result"
python3 - "$result" <<'ARESOS_JSON_EXPORT'
import base64, hashlib, json, pathlib, sys
raw = pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1]).read_bytes()
json.loads(raw)
print('\nARESOS_EXPORT_START')
print(base64.encodebytes(raw).decode(), end='')
print('ARESOS_EXPORT_END')
print('ARESOS_EXPORT_SHA256 ' + hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest() + '  guest.json')
ARESOS_JSON_EXPORT
